name: journal-of-quantitative-technological-economics
description: Use when targeting 《数量经济技术经济研究》(The Journal of Quantitative & Technological Economics, JQTE) — the CASS journal for quantitative economics, econometric methods, technical economics, input-output, macro-econometric forecasting, and technology/innovation evaluation. Apply when the contribution is method-application or measurement (productivity, efficiency, forecasting) rather than a pure causal-policy narrative.
